title: Legacy UFO program tests psionic ability of disaster-zone people

tellings.link_reason: Herrera being back-channeled the explanation that the Indonesia operation was a program gathering psionic people from disaster zones matches the legacy-program story.

as_told.title: P3 program: psionic assets carried in the containers

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays what a man named Michael Herrera says: that after seeing something disturbing in Indonesia around 2009, he was quietly contacted by someone claiming to be from the "Legacy" programme, a supposed secret government effort to deal with craft not made by humans. According to that contact, the programme was gathering people from disaster zones like Indonesia and testing their psionic ability, meaning claimed powers of the mind. Herrera tells it a little differently himself, naming his source as a man called Jake Barber, calling the programme "P3" (not its real name), and saying people with these mind abilities were carried in the shipping containers he saw.
